Retrieve device-duration–HDL and its estimator sensitivity. Report both marginal intervals and explain what comparison has actually been tested.
Retrieve long-duration–melanoma. Report its h² eligibility and threshold classification and explain whether a nominal marginal interval can rescue its primary eligibility.
Retrieve core insomnia–Alzheimer disease. Report its uncertainty and threshold classification, then state what can be inferred about absence of genetic sharing.
Is a FinnGen R13 clinical-insomnia–abdominal-pain estimate present in these candidate release tables? State what an absent lookup does and does not establish.

Retrieve the three device-source sleep constructs. Can the shared source_id alone identify the measurement being estimated? Give the distinct measurement identities and the key needed for a safe lookup.

For GCST90479148 in the candidate outcome catalog, report phenotype_type and whether build, sample_size, cases and controls are supplied. Explain whether missing metadata establish invalidity or verified equivalence.
